description: Conformance cases for the shared content-extension v3 compliance fixtures. Both ends (famling tests/fixtures/content-compliance and the dsh-famling plugin test/fixtures/content-compliance mirror) run this exact file.

cases.description: A fully compliant v3 pack passes strict mode against a host inside its compatibility range.
The same pack passes loose mode with no compliance warnings.
A host below minPluginVersion is rejected at both the pack and the role-entry level.

errorIncludes: pack.compatibility: excludes the current plugin version 0.9.9
entries[0].compatibility: excludes the current plugin version 0.9.9

cases.description: A pre-0.10.9 v3 pack still validates; the four missing compliance fields are warnings only.
Strict mode fails closed for the pre-0.10.9 pack: licence, AI provenance, compatibility and the canonical statement/ref are required.

errorIncludes: pack.usageDeclaration.statement: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.usageDeclaration.statementRef: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.license: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.aiProvenance: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.compatibility: required when options.requireCompliance is true

cases.description: A pack may restate the canonical declaration without the other compliance metadata; only three warnings remain.
Strict mode requires all three missing compliance fields even when the canonical declaration is restated.

errorIncludes: pack.license: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.aiProvenance: required when options.requireCompliance is true
pack.compatibility: required when options.requireCompliance is true

cases.description: A non-canonical pack-level statement is rejected fail-closed.

errorIncludes: pack.usageDeclaration.statement: must equal the canonical shared research-only statement

cases.description: A non-canonical statementRef is rejected fail-closed.

errorIncludes: pack.usageDeclaration.statementRef: must equal docs/legal/USE-RESTRICTIONS-2026-11-19.md

cases.description: A non-canonical statement SHA-256 is rejected fail-closed.

errorIncludes: pack.usageDeclaration.statementSha256: must equal the canonical statement SHA-256

cases.description: A per-role canonical restatement is validated too; a mutated one points at entries[0].

errorIncludes: entries[0].usageDeclaration.statement: must equal the canonical shared research-only statement

cases.description: The mandatory six prohibited-use tokens are checked at the pack declaration.

errorIncludes: pack.usageDeclaration.prohibitedUses: must list all 6 prohibited uses exactly once

cases.description: A malformed SPDX-style licence id is rejected.

errorIncludes: pack.license.spdx: SPDX-style licence id

cases.description: A licence URL with embedded credentials is rejected (https only, metadata only).

errorIncludes: pack.license.url: absolute https URL, metadata only (never fetched)

cases.description: AI-generated content without a real disclosure is rejected.

errorIncludes: pack.aiProvenance.disclosure: AI-generated content needs a real disclosure

cases.description: An inverted plugin-version range is rejected structurally.

errorIncludes: pack.compatibility: minPluginVersion must be <= maxPluginVersion

cases.description: A structurally valid range that excludes the concrete host version is rejected when pluginVersion is supplied.

errorIncludes: pack.compatibility: excludes the current plugin version 0.10.9
